dedupe_keys.name: slope stabilisation and modernisation of provincial road 975 at grodek nad dunajcem poland

description: This Climate-ADAPT case study documents how the Regional Roads Authority in Krakow secured rock-debris landslides along provincial road No. 975 at Gródek nad Dunajcem, on the shore of Lake Rożnowskie in Małopolska, Poland. The road links local tourism and business zones with national road 75 and the A4 motorway; storm rain on top of prolonged rain in 2010 destroyed half of the carriageway, and regional projections expect more torrential rainfall. Between August 2017 and March 2022 the project built a reinforced concrete grillage on bored piles to hold the slopes, rebuilt the road, replaced a bridge over the Szczecinówka stream and added a treated rainwater drainage system. Nature-based options were considered and judged insufficient for the scale of the threat. The total cost was PLN 19.0 million (about EUR 4.5 million), 85 percent from the European Regional Development Fund, and the design life is at least 50 years. The page was published on 4 March 2026 and is accessible online as free HTML with photos and links to the authority's project page. Caveats: benefits are described qualitatively, with no damage or traffic figures, and works on active landslides raised construction risk. The case illustrates climate adaptation and resilience of a regional road against landslide hazard driven by extreme rainfall; related records are the Holdfast Bay road corridor risk study and the US railroad climate hazard exposure data.
name: Slope stabilisation and modernisation of provincial road 975 at Gródek nad Dunajcem, Poland
organisations: Polish Geological Institute - National Research Institute
outcomes: Full trafficability of provincial road 975 was restored and the slopes stayed stable in later heavy-rain seasons; the works cost PLN 19.0 million (EUR 4.5 million), 85% EU funded, within the original financial plan.
provider: Climate-ADAPT (European Environment Agency), case study from the Regional Roads Authority in Krakow
